cuhkAdmission.introduction: Discover Your Place in a Global Language in Our English Programme Explore new ideas and unlock international perspectives through your encounters with English—as a language, culture(s) and literature. Our programme offers a strong sense of belonging, with students and faculty from around the world forming a dynamic intellectual community in which everyone thrives. Selecting from courses in literature, linguistics and creative writing, you have the opportunity to design your own academic journey and pursue your personal interests. Our flexible curriculum, stimulating double-major options, and transformative Oxford Summer Programme provide a solid academic foundation, while expanding your international horizons. Join us and find your voice in a global language.
cuhkAdmission.ranking: #44 in English Language and Literature (QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025)
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Our English programme opens not one, but many career pathways. Graduates have a strong foundation in analytical and creative thinking, cultural awareness and interpersonal communication. These highly adaptable skills are coveted by employers in diverse sectors, such as business, education, government, the arts and the media. Our graduates exemplify the versatility and influence of our programme, finding success in a variety of fields: Commerce and Industry: Approximately 27% enter the business and cultural sectors, excelling in publishing, art and design, and management positions. Education: About 27% pursue teaching careers in primary and secondary schools. Others: About 18% purse career in other sectors. Further Studies: About 28% pursue advanced degrees in Hong Kong or abroad. [Figures as of June 2023] Our programme supports undergraduate students with career advice events delivered by our alumni and with communication courses that foster the professional skills students need to succeed.
